description: This Java class 'TimerFormat' provides utility methods to format and display timer values, specifically converting milliseconds into a human-readable string format with hours, minutes, and seconds. It is used as a helper class in a timer application, based on an Android codebase.

classes.name: TimerFormat
classes.description: Final utility class for formatting timer durations into string representations.

methods.name: getTimeString
methods.description: Returns a formatted string of the given time in milliseconds, including hours, minutes, and seconds.
